discovery_notes: B419 follow-up 11 of B004 (DLR LE 2019). 26 standard searches. New: five 2019 Cast Member movie anniversary pins released at DLR and WDW (20,000 Leagues 65th, UP 10th, Tarzan 20th, Skeleton Dance 90th, Wonderful World of Color 65th) keyed under wdw with dlr variant notes; DLR resort gingerbread pins (Disneyland Hotel Ralph & Vanellope, Grand Californian Chip & Dale, LE 1,000, 16 Nov 2019); three DLR hotel holiday bells recorded but held (title-only). WDI/Mickey's of Glendale pins resolved as cast-store scope leads. No holds released.
